key_findings: Nociceptor subtypes in mouse lumbar DRG are born continuously from E9.5 to E13.5 with peak births at E10.5-E11.5; TRPV1+ and CGRP+ neurons peak over E10.5-E11.5.
IB4+ non-peptidergic C-fibers, TH+ C-LTMRs and Sst+ neurons peak at E11.5, whereas large myelinated TRKB/TRKC neurons are born mostly at E10.5.
